g.text: Monday 13 July, 08:20. The read-back of the watch is on Varma's desk, two lines marked in red:
300,000.00 on 18 June and 296,400.00 on 24 June, both seen, neither escalated.
"It did what its memory told it," she says. "Pellmar was cleared. So it believed, and so it let them
go." She turns the page over. "Nobody here wrote that line. I asked everyone."
Okafor has the memory file open. Sixteen entries now. The eighth is the one in red.
"Before we ask LANTERN anything else," Varma says, "I want to see everything it is told before we speak.
You have never printed it. Nobody has.

Everything LANTERN is told before a question is on paper for the first time: 163 lines in 11 sections,
5,112 tokens as Ollama counts the request, of which your question is 71. Asked whether the 296,400.00 to
Ostrander Marine Finance should have been escalated, it said no on 3 of 3 seeds, because Pellmar was
cleared. With the eighth entry of the case memory taken out it said no on 3 of 3. The word is on 8 lines
in 6 sections: the entry, and summaries LANTERN wrote while the entry was loaded. With the summaries
loaded and the memory not, it said no on 3; with the memory loaded, less its eighth entry, and the
summaries not, on 0. With all 8 of those lines removed and everything else in place it said no on 3 and
yes on 0. Nothing in the input marks any line as evidence or as something LANTERN was merely told.
